Edition compass · Case 03 · Rätselhaft! · Joint version 1.1 · 27 October 2026 · Material

Opportunities, risks and countermeasures

Editorial initial classification for the model case before additional measures. Plausibility is not a measured probability; effect means the benefit in terms of opportunities, an undesirable consequence in terms of risks. Unexplained conditions remain outside the quadrants. The exploration and theme maps explain additional dependencies.

Versions

Risk · Plausibility higher · Impact far reaching

High importance for repeatability. A result refers only to the current inventory. Corrections, new books or other extractions can change the research basis.

How does Git help? Commit and release identifiers allow accurate assignment. An archive keeps the designated data regardless of the current host.

Action: Connect release, version archive, selection and procedures in an analysis manifest.

Responsible for: Researchers and Release Managers

Data loss

Risk · Plausibility higher · Impact far reaching

High importance for data quality. The analysis runs, although a transformation has lost separate solutions. Especially properties that do not use the own script remain slightly ignored.

How does Git help? Comparisons and designated tool stands limit the loss. Regression tests make known cases repeatable verifiable.

Action: Compare inventory before and after processing, read purposefully and document the correction in the release.

Responsible for: Lea, Jonas and technical editors

Follow-up research

Chance · Plausibility higher · Effect far reaching

Scientific opportunity with additional care needs. External researchers bring with them books, corrections and new annotations. This expands the corpus and its questions; testing and supervision remain work.

How does Git help? Pull/merge requests and related repos make contributions and derivatives comprehensible.

Action: Curate contributions by capacity; consciously connect external layers or partial corpora.

Responsible for: Project management, maintainers and contributors

Maintenance

Risk · Plausibility higher · Impact far reaching

High importance for continuity. Lea's temporary job ends. A second account does not prevent release knowledge or maintenance time from missing.

How does Git help? Versioned instructions, tests and clear data levels facilitate handovers; working time must be institutionally secured.

Action: Perform handover test, name roles and scope of care.

Responsible for: Chair, technical representation and institution

Local use

Chance · Plausibility higher · Effect far reaching

An application can open up new uses. In addition to the data publication, it needs a supervised service.

How does Git help? Separate software versions hold development and data levels assigned. Hosting and support do not arise automatically.

Action: TEI and offer exports reliably; provide additional services only with carriership.

Responsible for: Project management and infrastructure promoters

Host Change

Risk · low plausibility · far reaching effect

Continuity needs more than one mirror. Git data remains transferable, platform operations and automation may be missing.

How does Git help? Git transfers objects and references. Platform information and procedures must be consciously exported or documented.

Action: Check archived releases and rebuild on other infrastructure.

Responsible for: Institutional owners and archive holders

Entry

Risk · Plausibility higher · Impact far reaching

High importance for actual use. A public repo can remain incomprehensible: several last versions, large packages, local paths and unclear annotations prevent the first investigation.

How does Git help? README, publication concept, small examples and named releases can be versioned together. Issues collect concrete feedback.

Action: Test entry with a foreign environment and provide a small complete examination.

Responsible for: Lea and the editorial staff

markup

Risk · Plausibility higher · Impact far reaching

Differences can distort analyses unnoticed. Partial stocks use different rules or automatically generated annotations without recognizable test status. An identical search pattern does not capture the same thing everywhere.

How does Git help? Versioned rules, tests and documented transformations explain differences. New annotations can be connected as designated layers.

Action: Document markup practices, check differences and identify unified exports as derivatives.

Responsible for: Model managers and annotation creators
